recoat_times.label: Waiting time to overcoating
recoat_times.text: Allow 15 hours at 23°C prior to the application of tile or levelling systems

recoat_times.label: Waiting time to overcoating
recoat_times.text: Allow 3 days at 23°C for impervious floor coverings or membranes

compat.text: Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed is applied in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor®, SikaBond®, Sikadur®, SikaTite® & Davco® ranges Applications are as follows > Internal & external space > Bonded screed from 10mm - 100mm > Un-bonded screed from 30mm - 80mm
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: ▪ Pre-mixed binder with selected aggregates ▪ High strength – ~40MPa after 28 days ▪ Good working time 20-30min @ 23°C ▪ Low shrinkage ▪ Tiles may be installed after 15hrs ▪ Suitable for all residential or commercial flooring installation
compat.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES

compat.text: ▪ The performance of cement-based materials is compromised when used above 35°C or below 5°C. ▪ Do not apply over substrates that may be subject to shrinkage after application. ▪ Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed is designed to be covered and not left exposed for long periods of time. ▪ Efflorescence in cement-based materials is beyond the control of the manufacturer. ▪ Expansion joints and all other AS standards must be followed during the installation process. ▪ Subsequent materials must be deemed as suitable and manufactures installation processes followed.
compat.heading: LIMITATIONS

compat.text: If the concrete substrate has efflorescence or high moisture (RH) and moisture sensitive flooring is being installed Sikafloor® Moisture Barrier System may be considered (Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier + Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime + Lankolatex 751/GP cement)

hazard_statements.statement: May cause an allergic skin reaction.
hazard_statements.text: H317 May cause an allergic skin reaction.

precautionary_statements.text: P264 Wash skin thoroughly after handling.

precautionary_statements.statement: Use only outdoors or in a well-ventilated area.
precautionary_statements.text: P271 Use only outdoors or in a well-ventilated area.

precautionary_statements.statement: Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.
precautionary_statements.text: P272 Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.
precautionary_statements.text: P280 Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.
precautionary_statements.text: P302 + P352 IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF INHALED: Remove person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing. Call a POISON CENTER/ doctor if you feel unwell.
precautionary_statements.text: P304 + P340 + P312 IF INHALED: Remove person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing. Call a POISON CENTER/ doctor if you feel unwell.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.
precautionary_statements.text: P305 + P351 + P338 + P310 IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.

precautionary_statements.statement: If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.
precautionary_statements.text: P333 + P313 If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.

precautionary_statements.statement: Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.
precautionary_statements.text: P362 + P364 Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.

precautionary_statements.statement: Store in a well-ventilated place. Keep container tightly closed.
precautionary_statements.text: P403 + P233 Store in a well-ventilated place. Keep container tightly closed.

precautionary_statements.statement: Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.
precautionary_statements.text: P501 Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Store in original container. Keep in a well-ventilated place. Observe label precautions. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products Sika 03 Do not breathe vapours/dust.

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.
